details:
I would like to request a feature that allows users to customize social visibility settings for individual friends.

Currently, VRChat provides general privacy settings, but these settings apply broadly. In some situations, users may want to stay friends with someone while controlling what information that specific person can see.

For example, users could have settings such as:

- Allow this friend to see which instance I am currently in

- Hide my current instance from this friend

- Allow or hide specific social information for individual friends

This would create a more flexible option between "fully visible" and "blocking someone".

In social VR, friendships can have many different levels of trust and interaction. A per-friend visibility system would allow users to maintain connections while also protecting their personal space.

This would help users feel more comfortable managing their social experience without needing to remove friends or use the block feature.
title: Per-friend social visibility settings
